- Solar eclipses
- Meteors/falling stars
- Directional phenomena/disturbances

- Echo phenomena
- Directional disturbances
- Earthquakes
- Other related arts of interpreting omens and signs

yojanaṭṭha: [Yojana+attha] (pu) CL=7 [Ttha-kiu ṭṭha-pru.. Nīti. Sutta, 107.]Have the meaning which is compared with (result of Kamma(consequence) of creature in te bhūmaka dhamma (which is being in three realms).
yojanikavihāra: [Yojanika+vihāra] (pu) CL=7 [Yojanika+sāsapa+puṇṇa+nagara] There are monasteries , they are one Yojana far from each and other.
yonisomanasikārādipaṭibaddha: [Yonisomanasikārādi+paṭibaddha] (ti) CL=7 Related to the cause of the status such as Yonisomanasikāra. (Yonisomanasikāra means equanimity (or) philosophical attitude).
yuganaddhapubbaṅgama: [Yuganaddha+pubbaṅgama] (ti) CL=7 It is foremost prescribed Yuganadha dhamma.
yujjhāpana: [Yudha+ya+ṇāpe+yu] (na) CL=7 Let him go into battle.
yūthikā: [Yūtha+i+ka+ā.dvayaṃcammeya] (thī) CL=7 [Iti khyāte. Yūtha hiṃsāyaṃ, sāyaṃ, isakatthe ko, dīghādi. Dhāna, ṭī. 576. Yūthaṃ puppharāsi assā atthītiyūthikā. Yūtha+ika. Kappadduma. Yūthikā-saṃ. Jūtiyā-prā] Jasmine plant, Jasmine flowers, Jvana flowers (small fragrant white flower Jasminum auriculatum).
